decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on the established and well-liked BASIC 518 trommel, so it fits the core screening portfolio, but it has not been seen on the website since 2018, which raises some doubt.

The high-speed grinder line broadens mobile shredding, but it had low visibility and no presence on the website in 2020 to 2021 after the related lines B and E were cut, so the risk of withdrawal is substantial.
This niche stationary electric fine shredder had little visibility and has not been seen since 2018, so its resources are better spent on the core mobile and stationary lines.
The stationary pre-shredder line had its own page and supports the firm's plant-based international strategy, though its absence from the website after 2018 adds some risk.
